notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Bloom Tender.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
You control a white, a blue, and a black permanent.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Bloom Tender with haste.
Activate the Bloom Tender token by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
